root_cause.text: Missing validation of the `optsnr` field in the `hbh_mt6_check()` function allows userspace to supply a value larger than the fixed-size `opts[IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR]` array, leading to an out-of-bounds array access.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message and CVE description state that `struct ip6t_opts` stores at most `IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR` (16) option descriptors, but `hbh_mt6_check()` does not reject larger `optsnr` values. The patch adds the check `if (optsinfo->optsnr > IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR) return -EINVAL;`. The UBSAN report shows index 16 is out of bounds for a `__u16 [16]` array, confirming the off-by-one vulnerability.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a boundary check to reject invocations with more than the allowed number of hop-by-hop options.
intent_record.what: Add a check in hbh_mt6_check() that returns -EINVAL if optsinfo->optsnr exceeds the maximum allowed value IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR, with a debug message.
intent_record.how: Prevents processing of netfilter match configurations that specify more than the supported number of hop-by-hop options, returning an error to userspace and avoiding potential buffer overruns or undefined behavior.
